name: com.gitshine/gitshine
title: GitShine
description: GitHub stats, Wrapped, comparisons and README cards for any user, repository or organization.

tools.name: get_github_stats
tools.description: A GitHub user's stats: contributions in the last 12 months and all time (year by year), longest and current streak, biggest day, commits/PRs/reviews/issues since joining, top languages by code size and most-starred repositories.

username.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

tools.name: get_github_wrapped
tools.description: A GitHub user's year in review: contributions and active days, longest streak, busiest day, month and weekday, top repositories and languages, achievements and a one-line persona.

username.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

year.description: Calendar year, from the year the account was created to this year. Defaults to this year.

tools.name: compare_github_profiles
tools.description: Two GitHub users' year side by side: contributions, active days, streaks, busiest month, work by type and top language.

a.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

b.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

year.description: Calendar year, from the year the account was created to this year. Defaults to this year.

tools.name: get_readme_card
tools.description: The Markdown line that puts GitShine's animated stats card (contribution graph, streaks, stars, top languages) on a GitHub profile README, with step-by-step instructions for adding it. Free, no token.

username.description: A GitHub username, @handle or profile URL (organizations aren't supported).

theme.description: auto (default) follows the viewer's light or dark mode; transparent has no background; dimmed, tokyonight, dracula and catppuccin are editor palettes.

layout.description: full (default): graph, totals, streaks and languages. Half width (pair two side by side): compact (streak), languages, week (contributions by weekday), repos (most-starred repositories). Full width: years (a bar per year), sky (the year as a night sky), wrapped (this year so far), achievements (GitHub's own achievements with how close the next tier is).

tools.name: get_repo_card
tools.description: The Markdown line for a GitShine card in a project's README, for any public GitHub repository. card=repo (default): stars, description, a year of weekly commits, open issues and pull requests. card=stars: star history, stars over time since the first one. card=contributors: avatars of the people who contributed. Includes steps for adding it.

repository.description: owner/name, or the repository's GitHub URL.

card.description: Which card: repo, stars or contributors.

tools.name: get_org_card
tools.description: The Markdown line for a GitShine card in a GitHub organization's profile README: total stars, top three repositories, how many are active this month and the main languages. Includes steps for adding it.

organization.description: The organization's login, like vercel, or its GitHub URL.
